name: Panjon Limited
about: Panjon Limited engages in the manufacture and trade of consumer and pharmaceutical products in India. It offers tablets, balms, cough syrups and drops, inhalers, hair oil, candies, digestive drops, energy drink, dental care creams, and mouth freshner, as well as awla, khajoor, chatpati, and shoppee products. The company sells its products under the Panjon, Hinkargiri, KERY, Percy, Swad, and Purti brand names. Panjon Limited was incorporated in 1964 and is based in Indore, India.
